text:
Alex: Quick sync — from INC-712 postmortem: we need to lock owners + realistic due dates for the follow-ups. I'm opening this thread to capture updates so we can close the RCA items by EOD next week.
Priya: Thanks. Can we list the outstanding items and current owners? I'll call out anything my team can't own.
Alex: Sure — current list (from RCA):
```
1) alert flood dedupe integration — owner: Eng (unassigned) — original due: 2026-03-20
2) graceful degraded-model fallback in runtime — owner: Eng-ml (Sara) — original due: 2026-03-22
3) deploy pipeline timeout tuning — owner: Eng-infra (Miguel) — original due: 2026-03-18
4) postmortem doc final review + product sign-off — owner: Product (James) — original due: 2026-03-17
5) retention and log sampling config — owner: Eng-sre (Priya) — original due: 2026-03-21
```
Miguel: I can keep deploy pipeline tuning but need until 2026-03-25 — there's a dependency on the k8s node image rollout. Noted.
Priya: For retention/log sampling I can take it but need clarity: is the goal short-term mitigation (reduce noise) or permanent policy change? If mitigation, I can do by 2026-03-23. For policy we'll need review cycle with compliance (extra week).
Sara: Confirming ML fallback item — I can implement the canary fallback change but want to split into two tasks: (A) runtime flag and (B) eval + perf tests. A by 2026-03-24, B by 2026-04-02. OK if we set owner to "Sara (Eng-ML)" and those two dates?
James: Product will do final doc sign-off. I can take it but need the SLA language from Priya's plan before signing. Can we target 2026-03-24 for sign-off conditional on Priya's mitigation?
Alex: Updated proposal:
```
1) alert dedupe integration — owner: Miguel (eng-infra) — new due: 2026-03-25 (Miguel confirmed)
2) graceful fallback runtime flag (A) — owner: Sara — due: 2026-03-24
   graceful fallback eval/tests (B) — owner: Sara — due: 2026-04-02
3) deploy pipeline timeout tuning — owner: Miguel — due: 2026-03-25
4) postmortem doc + product sign-off — owner: James — due: 2026-03-24 (depends on retention mitigation)
5) retention/log sampling mitigation — owner: Priya — due: 2026-03-23 (policy change tracked separately)
```
Priya: I can do mitigation by 2026-03-23. I'll drop the proposed config in #eng-sre and request compliance review if we want policy change.
Miguel: Confirming I'll own alert dedupe + deploy tuning, both due 2026-03-25. Will post PRs and link here.
Sara: Confirmed. I'll create two issues (flag + eval) and link the PRs.
James: I'll hold doc sign-off till I see Priya's mitigation notes. Target 2026-03-24 still works.
Alex: Great. Action items assigned. Quick checklist for follow-ups: everyone please post a single-line update in this thread when you open the PR/issue. I'll compile for the RCA close.
OpsBot: Incident INC-712 postmortem doc created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-712 — assigned owner Alex.
Priya: FYI tagging compliance: @compliance-team please note possible policy review next week.
Miguel: PR opened for pipeline timeouts: https://git.redwood/pipelines/PR-482 (update: tests failing, investigating)
Alex: Thanks — noted failing tests. Will ping eng-sre if you need infra checks.
Priya: Update: mitigation config posted in #eng-sre, link: https://workspace/eng-sre/threads/1234. I'll start compliance ping tomorrow.
Sara: Issue + draft PR for fallback flag created: https://git.redwood/eng-ml/issue/87 — will start perf runs tomorrow morning.
James: Draft postmortem doc updated with dependencies section and tentative sign-off conditions. Posting link in #product.
Alex: Closing loop — we'll reconvene asynchronously here. If any due date slips more than 48 hours, call it out with the reason and new ETA. :thumbsup:
